name: צִידוֹן
summary: The city of Sidon, from which Genesis traces the Canaanite boundary toward Gerar as far as Gaza; and Sidon, Canaan’s firstborn, whose name it shares. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The boundary begins מִצִּידֹן, “from Sidon,” and proceeds toward Gerar.

note: Moved from the former word entry `9iydwon`. The old root key צידונ used the place name’s own consonants. Sidon@Gen.10.15, the son of Canaan, is added as a bearer of the same spelling; no name entry named him before.
